Other profiles & external brackets
Pipe penetrations — every flue, vent and pipe you draw picks its own boot size and back-tray
Pipe flashings — Aquaseal / Dektite ($/each) — the size is chosen from the pipe's outside diameter. Leave blank for $0.
Back-trays ($/lm) — trays are folded to each pipe's own tray length, so this is a rate per metre, not per tray. Leave blank for $0.
Downpipes — one downpipe per gutter line

Fergus — Sales Account Codes
Fergus categorises every quote line by a Sales Account. Paste the numeric ids of your Material Sales and Labour accounts — find them in Fergus → Settings → Sales Account Codes (click the row; the id is the trailing number in the URL). Material lines (materials, scaffold, selections) use the material account; labour lines use the labour account.
The optional code fields are sent on each line as a product/item code if your Fergus setup uses them.
Phase 2: "Send job to JMS" + "Email quote" buttons (and the JMS adapters for ServiceM8, Jobber, Tradify) ship in the next iteration. Fergus push already works from the Fergus tab.
Send feedback

Report a bug or request a feature — it goes straight to the team, not into a ticket queue. Most issues are fixed within about two hours of landing with us, and you will get an email when yours is done.

The more detail you give, the faster and more thoroughly we can fix it. A line like “pricing is wrong” means we have to guess which roof and which number, and a guess usually means a second round. Be specific about what looked wrong and what it should have been, and we can normally reproduce it on the first read and fix the real cause rather than patching the symptom.

You do not need to write down your browser, your screen, which tab you were on or what the app was doing — that is all captured and attached for us automatically, along with the roof you were looking at.
1 Title
A short summary of the issue or idea.
2 Details
Just describe what looks wrong, in your own words — the more specific the better. Which lines, which measurement, which number, and what it should have been. Everything else is captured for us automatically.
3 Screenshots — optional
Attach images if they help show the issue.
Sent with this so the issue can be reproduced: your roof drawing's measurements (outline, lines and scale), which build and screen you were on, what the app was doing, and any errors from this session. No client, address, photos or prices.
